title: 9 Signs Your Grind Is Actually Just Running From God
caption:
Hustle culture will let you sprint straight past God and call it faithfulness.

Grind isn't the enemy. Running is, and running dressed up as ambition is the hardest kind to catch. Check the calendar before you check the revenue.

Which of these is actually you right now?
